basic_details.job_title: Central Bank of India Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline Faculty, Office Assistant Posts

age_limit.details: The age limit for candidates applying for the posts is between 22 to 40 years with sound health as on 30/09/2026.

qualification.details: Candidates should be residents of the same State (Maharashtra), preferably the same or nearby district/residing at the headquarters of the RSETI centre.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 30,000/- per month (Faculty), Rs. 20,000/- per month (Office Assistant)
salary_details.details: No other allowances/reimbursement of expenses will be admissible.

selection_process: The eligible candidates will be called for a personal interview and the decision of the Bank in this regard shall be final.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website of Central Bank of India at https://www.centralbank.bank.in to download the application form.
Fill out the application form in the given format (Annexure-A).
Affix a passport size photograph on the application form and sign across the photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, computer certificates, identity card, address details, and experience certificates (if any).
Place the application inside an envelope and subscribe it with "Application for the post of Faculty/ Office Assistant at RSETI, Yavatmal on contract for the year 2026-27".

Send or submit the application by post or in person to the Regional Head, Central Bank of India, 1st floor, Platinum Empire Building, Opposite Teosa Jin, Cotton Market Road, Amravati 444601 on or before 21.10.2026.
important_instructions: Candidates must ensure they fulfill the eligibility criteria before applying. Incomplete applications will be rejected. Applications received after 21.10.2026 will not be entertained. The candidate shall be appointed on a contract basis for a period of one year, and renewal may be possible at the Bank's sole discretion. Candidates shall be entitled to 12 days of leave per year with a maximum of 02 days per month. Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claims or disputes can be instituted only at Mumbai courts/tribunals/forums.

content_sections.text: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the Faculty and Office Assistant posts at RSETI Yavatmal.

content_sections.heading: Central Bank of India Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates should be residents of the same State (Maharashtra), preferably the same or nearby district/residing at the headquarters of the RSETI centre.

rows.qualification_required: Shall be a Graduate (any i.e., Science/Commerce/Arts) / Post-Graduate; however, preference may be given to MSW/MA in Rural Development/MA in Sociology/Psychology/ B.Sc. (Veterinary), B.Sc. (Horticulture), B.Sc. (Agri.), B.Sc.(Agri. Marketing)/B.A. with B.Ed. etc. Shall have a flair for teaching with Computer knowledge. Excellent communication skills in the local language essential, fluency in English and Hindi will be an added advantage. Skills in Typing in Local Language essential. Typing skills in Hindi/English typing, an added advantage. Previous experience as Faculty preferred. Should be well conversant with local language (Marathi).

Shall be a Graduate viz. BSW/BA/B.Com/ with computer knowledge. Knowledge in Basic Accounting is a preferred qualification. Shall be fluent in spoken and written local language. Fluency in Hindi/English would be an added advantage. Shall be proficient in MS Office (Word & Excel), Tally & Internet. Skills in typing in local language are essential, Typing skills in English an added advantage. Should be well conversant with local language (Marathi).

faq.question: Q1. What is the Central Bank of India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive announced by Central Bank of India, Regional Office Amravati, to hire Faculty and Office Assistant posts on a contract basis at RSETI Yavatmal.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available, with 2 vacancies for Faculty and 2 vacancies for Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 21.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate (Science/Commerce/Arts) or Post-Graduate, with preference given to MSW/MA in Rural Development/Sociology/Psychology, B.Sc. in Veterinary/Horticulture/Agri./Agri. Marketing, or B.A. with B.Ed., along with teaching flair, computer knowledge, and local language proficiency.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate (BSW/BA/B.Com) with computer knowledge, proficiency in MS Office (Word & Excel), Tally, Internet, and local language typing skills.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 22 and 40 years of age with sound health as on 30/09/2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: There is no application fee prescribed for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The contract amount is fixed at Rs. 30,000/- per month for Faculty and Rs. 20,000/- per month for Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach required self-attested documents, and submit it offline by post or in person to the Regional Head, Central Bank of India, Amravati.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be called for a personal interview, and the decision of the Bank in this regard shall be final.
